stem: Which reason explains the population increase shown in the table?

options.label: A
options.text: The Gadsden Purchase established new states in the West.

options.label: B
options.text: Farmers left northern cities for rural plains in the West.

options.label: C
options.text: The Louisiana Purchase opened up settlement in the West.

options.label: D
options.text: Gold was discovered in the West.
